# Architecture Design

Use this skill when creating end-to-end architecture documents.

## Procedure

1. Capture raw input exactly.
2. Identify systems, actors, trust boundaries, environments, and source-of-truth systems.
3. Define current state, target state, and transition approach.
4. Define component responsibilities and interface contracts.
5. Document authentication, authorization, network, audit, data, secret handling, and compliance controls.
6. Document operational workflows, failure modes, rollback, support, monitoring, and runbooks.
7. Create decisions, assumptions, risks, and open questions.
8. Assign freeze readiness.

Use the main template: [architecture document template](../../../templates/end-to-end-architecture.md).
